note: Addendum A §1.2/§1.4. Method-specific, rotated, never praise of the child. Six per mechanic family so nothing feels canned by day three.

code: You found the rule and used it.
wordweb: You matched the meaning, not the look.
You saw past the trick word.
bridge: You kept the pair the right way round.
deduction: You ruled them out one by one.
You used only what the clues say.
You lined them up in order.
forge: You held the whole number steady — place by place.
Estimated first — that's the pro move.
Fact recalled, job done — the forge hums.
You built it from a fact you already own.
workshop: You found the maths hiding in the words.
Priced the job step by step — that's the craft.
You turned a story into a sum. That's the whole trade.
Model first, method second — built like a pro.
You knew exactly what the mystery part was.
markhomework: You found the slip — sharp eyes.
Checked every step like a real marker.
You didn't just spot it — you knew why it happened.
One step out of place, and you caught it.
You read the working the way a teacher does.
The fix was yours before the page turned.
datadesk: You read the chart, not just the picture.
Straight to the row that mattered.
You checked the scale before you answered — that's the skill.
The table gave it up the moment you interrogated it.
You followed the data, not the guess.
Timetable decoded like a seasoned traveller.
shapeshop: You saw the shape move before it moved.
Area and perimeter — you kept them apart.
The mirror line landed exactly where it belongs.
You read the grid like a map.
Turned it in your head first — that's the move.
